1	---
     2	name: frontend-design
     3	description: Expert frontend design guidelines for creating beautiful, modern UIs. Use when building landing pages, dashboards, or any user interface.
     4	metadata: {"clawdbot":{"emoji":"🎨"}}
     5	---
     6	
     7	# Frontend Design Skill
     8	
     9	Use this skill when creating UI components, landing pages, dashboards, or any frontend design work.
    10	
    11	## Design Workflow
    12	
    13	Follow this structured approach for UI design:
    14	
    15	1. **Layout Design** — Think through component structure, create ASCII wireframes
    16	2. **Theme Design** — Define colors, fonts, spacing, shadows
    17	3. **Animation Design** — Plan micro-interactions and transitions
    18	4. **Implementation** — Generate the actual code
    19	
    20	### 1. Layout Design
    21	
    22	Before coding, sketch the layout in ASCII format:
    23	
    24	```
    25	┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
    26	│         HEADER / NAV BAR            │
    27	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    28	│                                     │
    29	│            HERO SECTION             │
    30	│         (Title + CTA)               │
    31	│                                     │
    32	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    33	│   FEATURE   │  FEATURE  │  FEATURE  │
    34	│     CARD    │   CARD    │   CARD    │
    35	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    36	│            FOOTER                   │
    37	└─────────────────────────────────────┘
    38	```
    39	
    40	### 2. Theme Guidelines
    41	
    42	**Color Rules:**
    43	- NEVER use generic bootstrap-style blue (#007bff) — it looks dated
    44	- Prefer oklch() for modern color definitions
    45	- Use semantic color variables (--primary, --secondary, --muted, etc.)
    46	- Consider both light and dark mode from the start
    47	
    48	**Font Selection (Google Fonts):**
    49	```
    50	Sans-serif: Inter, Roboto, Poppins, Montserrat, Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, Space Grotesk
    51	Monospace: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, Source Code Pro, IBM Plex Mono, Space Mono, Geist Mono
    52	Serif: Merriweather, Playfair Display, Lora, Source Serif Pro, Libre Baskerville
    53	Display: Architects Daughter, Oxanium
    54	```
    55	
    56	**Spacing & Shadows:**
    57	- Use consistent spacing scale (0.25rem base)
    58	- Shadows should be subtle — avoid heavy drop shadows
    59	- Consider using oklch() for shadow colors too
    60	
    61	### 3. Theme Patterns
    62	
    63	**Modern Dark Mode (Vercel/Linear style):**
    64	```css
    65	:root {
    66	  --background: oklch(1 0 0);
    67	  --foreground: oklch(0.145 0 0);
    68	  --primary: oklch(0.205 0 0);
    69	  --primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0 0);
    70	  --secondary: oklch(0.970 0 0);
    71	  --muted: oklch(0.970 0 0);
    72	  --muted-foreground: oklch(0.556 0 0);
    73	  --border: oklch(0.922 0 0);
    74	  --radius: 0.625rem;
    75	  --font-sans: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
    76	}
    77	```
    78	
    79	**Neo-Brutalism (90s web revival):**
    80	```css
    81	:root {
    82	  --background: oklch(1 0 0);
    83	  --foreground: oklch(0 0 0);
    84	  --primary: oklch(0.649 0.237 26.97);
    85	  --secondary: oklch(0.968 0.211 109.77);
    86	  --accent: oklch(0.564 0.241 260.82);
    87	  --border: oklch(0 0 0);
    88	  --radius: 0px;
    89	  --shadow: 4px 4px 0px 0px hsl(0 0% 0%);
    90	  --font-sans: DM Sans, sans-serif;
    91	  --font-mono: Space Mono, monospace;
    92	}
    93	```
    94	
    95	**Glassmorphism:**
    96	```css
    97	.glass {
    98	  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    99	  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
   100	  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
   101	  border-radius: 1rem;
   102	}
   103	```
   104	
   105	### 4. Animation Guidelines
   106	
   107	**Micro-syntax for planning:**
   108	```
   109	button: 150ms [S1→0.95→1] press
   110	hover: 200ms [Y0→-2, shadow↗]
   111	fadeIn: 400ms ease-out [Y+20→0, α0→1]
   112	slideIn: 350ms ease-out [X-100→0, α0→1]
   113	bounce: 600ms [S0.95→1.05→1]
   114	```
   115	
   116	**Common patterns:**
   117	- Entry animations: 300-500ms, ease-out
   118	- Hover states: 150-200ms
   119	- Button press: 100-150ms
   120	- Page transitions: 300-400ms
   121	
   122	### 5. Implementation Rules
   123	
   124	**Tailwind CSS:**
   125	```html
   126	<!-- Import via CDN for prototypes -->
   127	<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
   128	```
   129	
   130	**Flowbite (component library):**
   131	```html
   132	<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flowbite@2.0.0/dist/flowbite.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
   133	<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flowbite@2.0.0/dist/flowbite.min.js"></script>
   134	```
   135	
   136	**Icons (Lucide):**
   137	```html
   138	<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>
   139	<script>lucide.createIcons();</script>
   140	```
   141	
   142	**Images:**
   143	- Use real placeholder services: Unsplash, placehold.co
   144	- Never make up image URLs
   145	- Example: `https://images.unsplash.com/photo-xxx?w=800&h=600`
   146	
   147	### 6. Responsive Design
   148	
   149	Always design mobile-first and responsive:
   150	
   151	```css
   152	/* Mobile first */
   153	.container { padding: 1rem; }
   154	
   155	/* Tablet */
   156	@media (min-width: 768px) {
   157	  .container { padding: 2rem; }
   158	}
   159	
   160	/* Desktop */
   161	@media (min-width: 1024px) {
   162	  .container { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }
   163	}
   164	```
   165	
   166	### 7. Accessibility
   167	
   168	- Use semantic HTML (header, main, nav, section, article)
   169	- Include proper heading hierarchy (h1 → h2 → h3)
   170	- Add aria-labels to interactive elements
   171	- Ensure sufficient color contrast (4.5:1 minimum)
   172	- Support keyboard navigation
   173	
   174	### 8. Component Design Tips
   175	
   176	**Cards:**
   177	- Subtle shadows, not heavy drop shadows
   178	- Consistent padding (p-4 to p-6)
   179	- Hover state: slight lift + shadow increase
   180	
   181	**Buttons:**
   182	- Clear visual hierarchy (primary, secondary, ghost)
   183	- Adequate touch targets (min 44x44px)
   184	- Loading and disabled states
   185	
   186	**Forms:**
   187	- Clear labels above inputs
   188	- Visible focus states
   189	- Inline validation feedback
   190	- Adequate spacing between fields
   191	
   192	**Navigation:**
   193	- Sticky header for long pages
   194	- Clear active state indication
   195	- Mobile-friendly hamburger menu
   196	
   197	---
   198	
   199	## Quick Reference
   200	
   201	| Element | Recommendation |
   202	|---------|---------------|
   203	| Primary font | Inter, Outfit, DM Sans |
   204	| Code font | JetBrains Mono, Fira Code |
   205	| Border radius | 0.5rem - 1rem (modern), 0 (brutalist) |
   206	| Shadow | Subtle, 1-2 layers max |
   207	| Spacing | 4px base unit (0.25rem) |
   208	| Animation | 150-400ms, ease-out |
   209	| Colors | oklch() for modern, avoid generic blue |
   210	
   211	---
   212	
   213	*Based on SuperDesign patterns — https://superdesign.dev*

1	# ShiftWise — Simplify Restaurant Team Management
     2	
     3	## Brand
     4	ShiftWise is an all-in-one workforce management platform built for the restaurant and hospitality industry. It helps owners and managers streamline scheduling, team communication, and labor compliance — so they can focus on running great restaurants instead of wrestling with spreadsheets.
     5	
     6	Tone: Professional, modern, bold
     7	Brand colors: #0051C3 (primary blue), #DE5052 (accent red), #FFFFFF (white)
     8	
     9	## Hero Content
    10	Title: Your Restaurant Runs Better When Your Team Is in Sync
    11	Subtitle: ShiftWise gives restaurant owners and managers the scheduling, communication, and compliance tools they need — all in one platform. Spend less time on admin and more time delighting guests.
    12	CTA: "Start Your Free Trial" | "See How It Works"
    13	
    14	## How It Works
    15	1. **Build Your Schedule** — Use drag-and-drop tools to create optimized weekly schedules in minutes, not hours.
    16	2. **Keep Everyone Connected** — Broadcast shift updates, swap requests, and announcements through built-in team messaging.
    17	3. **Stay Compliant Automatically** — Get real-time alerts for overtime, break violations, and local labor law requirements.
    18	4. **Track & Optimize** — Monitor labor costs, attendance trends, and team performance from a single dashboard.
    19	
    20	## Core Features
    21	- **Drag-and-drop scheduling** — Build and publish weekly schedules with an intuitive visual editor. Auto-fill based on availability and roles.
    22	- **Team messaging** — Communicate with individuals, shift groups, or your entire staff. No more lost group texts.
    23	- **Labor law compliance alerts** — Automatic notifications for overtime thresholds, predictive scheduling laws, and mandatory break periods.
    24	- **POS integrations** — Connect with leading point-of-sale systems to align labor costs with real-time sales data.
    25	- **Time clocking** — GPS-enabled clock-in/clock-out from any mobile device. Eliminate buddy punching with photo verification.
    26	
    27	## Feature: Scheduling
    28	Create conflict-free schedules in minutes. ShiftWise automatically factors in employee availability, time-off requests, certifications, and labor budget targets. Managers can copy previous weeks, use templates, or let the auto-scheduler do the heavy lifting. Employees receive instant mobile notifications when schedules are published or updated.
    29	
    30	## Feature: Team Communication
    31	Replace scattered text threads with a centralized messaging hub. Send shift reminders, broadcast announcements, and manage shift swap requests — all within the app. Read receipts ensure critical messages are seen, and managers can pin important updates for new hires.
    32	
    33	## Feature: Labor Compliance
    34	Navigate complex and ever-changing labor regulations with confidence. ShiftWise monitors federal, state, and local labor laws — including predictive scheduling ordinances, minor work-hour restrictions, and overtime rules — and flags potential violations before they happen.
    35	
    36	## Integrations
    37	ShiftWise connects seamlessly with the tools restaurants already use:
    38	- **Point of Sale** — Toast, Square, Clover, Lightspeed
    39	- **Payroll** — ADP, Gusto, Paychex, QuickBooks
    40	- **Accounting** — Xero, FreshBooks, Sage
    41	- **Delivery platforms** — DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub
    42	
    43	## Platform Stats
    44	- **750,000+** shifts scheduled every month
    45	- **35,000+** restaurant managers on the platform
    46	- **98%** customer satisfaction rate
    47	- **15 hrs/week** average time saved per manager
    48	
    49	## Pricing Plans
    50	
    51	| Feature | Free | Starter ($29.99/mo) | Premium ($69.99/mo) |
    52	|---|---|---|---|
    53	| Locations | 1 | Up to 3 | Unlimited locations |
    54	| Employees | Up to 15 | Up to 50 | Unlimited |
    55	| Drag-and-drop scheduling | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
    56	| Team messaging | — | ✓ | ✓ |
    57	| Labor compliance alerts | — | Basic | Advanced |
    58	| POS integrations | — | ✓ | ✓ |
    59	| Time clocking | — | ✓ | ✓ |
    60	| Demand forecasting | — | — | ✓ |
    61	| Dedicated account manager | — | — | ✓ |
    62	| Support | Email | Email & chat | Priority 24/7 |
    63	
    64	Annual billing saves 20% on Starter and Premium plans.
    65	
    66	## FAQ
    67	- **Is there really a free plan?** — Yes. The Free plan supports one location with up to 15 employees, no credit card required.
    68	- **Can I switch plans at any time?** — Absolutely. Upgrade, downgrade, or cancel anytime from your account settings.
    69	- **Do you offer discounts for multi-location operators?** — Yes. Contact our sales team for custom enterprise pricing on 10+ locations.
    70	- **What happens to my data if I cancel?** — Your data is retained for 90 days after cancellation. You can export everything at any time.
    71	- **Is there a setup fee?** — No. All plans include free onboarding and setup assistance.
    72	
    73	## Testimonials
    74	- "ShiftWise cut our scheduling time from 6 hours to 30 minutes every week. It's been a game-changer for our three-location operation." — **Maria Gonzalez**, General Manager, Fuego Kitchen
    75	- "The compliance alerts alone have saved us from costly violations. I sleep better knowing ShiftWise has our back." — **David Park**, Owner, Noodle Republic
    76	- "Our staff actually loves it — shift swaps happen in seconds and everyone stays in the loop." — **Aisha Thompson**, Operations Director, Greenleaf Café Group
    77	
    78	## Mission
    79	ShiftWise was founded in 2019 by a team of former restaurant operators and software engineers who experienced the chaos of workforce management firsthand. Our mission is to empower every restaurant — from single-unit independents to national chains — with technology that makes managing people as seamless as serving guests.
    80	
    81	## Team
    82	CEO: Rachel Nguyen · CTO: Marcus Webb · CPO: Sofia Alvarez · VP of Customer Success: James Okafor
    83	
    84	## Contact
    85	Have questions or need a personalized demo? Reach out and our team will respond within one business day.
    86	- **Email:** hello@shiftwise.io
    87	- **Phone:** (415) 555-0192
    88	- **Office Locations:** San Francisco, CA (HQ) · Austin, TX · Toronto, ON
    89	
    90	Contact form fields: Full Name, Email, Company Name, Number of Locations, Message

    93	Title: Ready to Simplify Your Restaurant Operations?
    94	Subtitle: Join 35,000+ managers who save 15 hours every week with ShiftWise.
    95	CTA: "Start Your Free Trial — No Credit Card Required"

todos.title: Create shared CSS and JS assets

steps.message:
The ShiftWise 5-page marketing website is complete and all files have been output to `/app/output/`. Here's a summary of what was built:

---

### Pages
| Page | File | Key Sections |
|------|------|-------------|
| **Home** | `index.html` | Hero, Features, How It Works, Testimonials, Stats, Pricing Teaser, CTA |
| **Features** | `features.html` | Hero, Scheduling, Team Communication, Labor Compliance, Integrations, CTA |
| **Pricing** | `pricing.html` | Hero, Pricing Table (3 tiers), FAQ Accordion, CTA |
| **About** | `about.html` | Hero, Mission, Team, Stats, CTA |
| **Contact** | `contact.html` | Hero, Contact Form, Office Locations |

### Shared Assets
- **`vendor/css/styles.css`** — Complete design system with variables, components, responsive grid, and animations
- **`vendor/js/main.js`** — All interactive behaviors

### Interactions Implemented
| Interaction | Behavior |
|-------------|----------|
| **Mobile nav toggle** | Hamburger opens a slide-in drawer with backdrop; close via X, backdrop click, or Escape key |
| **Testimonial carousel** | Prev/next arrows + dot navigation; auto-advances every 6 seconds |
| **Pricing toggle** | Monthly/Annual switch updates Starter ($29.99↔$23.99) and Premium ($69.99↔$55.99) prices; "Save 20%" badge shown |
| **FAQ accordion** | Click to expand/collapse answers; only one open at a time |
| **Contact form validation** | Client-side validation on required fields + email format; success message replaces form on valid submit |
| **Stats count-up** | Animated count-up triggered when stats scroll into view |
| **Scroll reveal** | Elements fade in as they enter the viewport |

### Design Choices
- **Colors:** Deep navy (`#0f1a2e`) + primary blue (`#0051C3`) + warm accent red (`#DE5052`) — professional, modern, and bold
- **Typography:** Space Grotesk for headings, Inter for body text
- **Responsive:** Mobile-first with breakpoints at 640px, 768px, and 1024px
- **Accessibility:** Semantic HTML, ARIA labels, focus states, keyboard navigation, reduced-motion support
